svg.title: Button centre spacing: 60 cm opening and seven centres
svg.desc: Seven centre points at 3, 12, 21, 30, 39, 48 and 57 centimetres from the top of a 60-centimetre opening. Equal top and bottom offsets are 3 centimetres. The 54-centimetre centre span is divided into six 9-centimetre intervals. AI-assisted programmatic authorship by Sewlore. No physical testing was performed.

svg.text: Seven centres create six equal intervals
Opening: 60 cm · Top offset: 3 cm · Bottom offset: 3 cm · Count: 7 centres
centre i = a + i × spacing, for i = 0, 1, …, 6
Offsets locate centre points; button diameters and garment fit need separate checks.
Hypothetical example. Prepared by Sewlore with AI-assisted programmatic drawing.
